page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable rules and rubrics injected into the prompts of the agents that carry them.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Write a skill by hand, import one from a file, or fetch one from a URL.

drawer.title: Add skill
drawer.subtitle: Write one by hand, import a .md or .zip, or fetch one from a URL.

archive.nothingExecuted: Nothing in the archive was executed — every entry was only parsed in memory.
archive.noCore: No markdown skill file found in this archive.

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Imported content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.
file.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side (public hosts only), stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted. Link the raw .md or a .zip, not an HTML page.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

security.flaggedTitle: Possible prompt injection — edit the body before enabling
security.bannerBody: {count, plural, one {# line matches} other {# lines match}} a known injection pattern. This skill cannot be enabled until those lines are edited.
security.importNote: You can still import it: it lands disabled, and stays disabled until the flagged lines are edited in the editor.
security.toggleDisabled: Enabling is blocked while the body is flagged — edit it in Config first.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.noteHint: Shown on the version this save creates. Only recorded when the body actually changes.
config.notePlaceholder: e.g. Tightened the wording on rule 3

versions.title: Versions
versions.noChanges: No change to the body in this version.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This appends a new version with this body — it does not remove any version after it.
versions.diffVsCurrentTitle: v{from} → v{to} — what the current version changed since this one

stats.title: Stats
stats.noCategories: No findings in the last 30 days.
stats.attributionCaveat: These numbers count runs of the agents this skill is attached to — a finding can't be traced back to a specific skill.

create.subtitle: A skill is prompt text — rules or a rubric — injected into the agents that carry it.
create.name: Name
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What this skill asks the reviewer to check

delete.title: Delete skill?
delete.body: "{name}" will be removed from every agent that carries it. This cannot be undone.
